ELI5: Why is minimum wage bad (because businesses will have to pay workers more) but deporting illegal immigrants good (because businesses will have to pay workers more?

Illegal immigrants sustain a low wage system by providing a surplus of workers to a limited pool of jobs. Deporting the illegals will decrease the cheap labor pool allowing Americans to have more opportunities for jobs. These American workers will obviously want higher wages and employers will be forced to pay that to make up for the lost illegal workers. The businesses will raise their prices to compensate for the increased labor costs, but, unlike when the illegal workers were in the equation, the American workers will have more income to spend on those higher priced goods and services. The net result should be more employed legal citizens with higher wages and businesses that are still profitable despite paying higher wages for legal workers. Keep this cycle going for some time and the system balances out with more people working and less government welfare dollars being needed to sustain low income and non-working citizens thereby further strengthening the economy and workforce.
